arguments.value: Shi Farms agreed to sell Gridiron 30,000 pounds of hemp biomass for $5 per pound, for a total of $150,000. The biomass had to meet specified quality standards, including at least 6% CBD/CBDA, less than 3% THC, and no unacceptable contaminants. Payment was due when the agreement was signed, after which Shi Farms would hold the product until delivery. Shi Farms would ship samples to a lab chosen by Gridiron if needed, and deliver the biomass to a processor chosen by Gridiron. Either party could end the agreement before delivery. Gridiron agreed to indemnify Shi Farms for certain claims and losses. The agreement required written notices, treated the contract as confidential, governed disputes under Colorado law, and could only be changed in writing signed by both parties.
